mapper.select: SELECT m.name FROM club_officer co JOIN member m ON m.member_id = co.member_id WHERE co.position_code = #{position} AND m.member_status_code = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO club_officer (position_code, member_id, appointed_dttm) VALUES (#{position}, #{memberId}, #{appointedDttm})
mapper.update: UPDATE club_officer SET member_id = #{memberId}, appointed_dttm = #{appointedDttm}, updated_dttm = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE position_code = #{position}
